segments.text: Hi, I am Sandra Leight, from England. The position I'm applying for is Digital Marketing for Newton F.C., my current post Digital Marketing for the company Abbey Logistics in Manchester.
I simplify strategy by focusing on outcomes, reach, engagement, conversions, rather than technical jargon. I use visuals and plain language to make sure every stakeholder understands the value.

I research each audience and adapt tone and format accordingly, professional for clubs, inspirational for players, reassuring for parents. Platform-specific content ensures maximum relevance for each group.
I establish a clear, creative brief aligning everyone on goals and deadlines before execution. I act as the central coordination point with regular check-ins to keep all elements on track.
I conduct an honest post-campaign analysis and present leadership with a clear recovery plan and revised KPIs. Accountability builds more trust than excuses.
I monitor platform updates proactively and diversify content across multiple channels so no single algorithm change derails a campaign. Flexibility is built into every strategy from the start.
When a paid campaign underperformed I paused it, rebuilt the audience segments and adjusted the creative. The relaunched campaign exceeded the original target by 30%.
I use a 30-60-90-day planning framework mapped to business objectives with project management tools to track tasks and approvals. Nothing gets published without proper review.
I start by defining clear KPIs, build the campaign around audience and message, then monitor daily and optimize weekly. A full ROI report closes every campaign.
Every piece of content goes through a strict review process to ensure it is accurate, brand-aligned and legally compliant before publishing.
When asked to exaggerate product results I declined, explained the risks and proposed an alternative.
